newsitem.title: TAIWAN: French MICA missiles delivered to Taiwan - paper.
newsitem.headline: French MICA missiles delivered to Taiwan - paper.

text.p: Taiwan has taken delivery of 960 French air-to-air MICA misslies that it ordered from France, the China Times reported on Sunday.
The newspaper said the missiles will be loaded on 60 Mirage 2000-5 fighters Taiwan has ordered from France.
A Taiwanese defence ministry spokesman declined to comment on the report.
In early 1993 France said it would sell 60 Mirage 2000-5 fighter aircrafts to Taiwan, which also ordered from the French six Lafayette-class missile frigates.

Facing rising military threats from China, Taiwan's rival since the end of a civil war in 1949, Taipei has bolstered air defences in recent years. In addition to the Mirages, Taiwan has also ordered 150 F-16 fighter jets from the United States.
After France announced the 1993 Mirage deal, China ordered the closure of the French consulate in the southern city of Guangzhou and cut French firms out of major contracts.
